children: A British Bitcoin investor has recovered 61 BTC that he lost access to after the collapse of an early crypto exchange in 2014. The coins are now worth about £3.3 million ($5 million), turning an original £1,500 investment into a multimillion-pound fortune after a 12-year fight.
He says he plans to buy a bigger home and hold onto the rest.
£1,500 Bitcoin Investment Became a Fortune
The investor, identified only as Chris, bought Bitcoin in 2011 after a friend convinced him that the cryptocurrency could become valuable.
He invested around £1,500, and within a few weeks, the value started rising. By the time the exchange began running into trouble, his Bitcoin was worth about £4,000.
Chris had stored the Bitcoin through Intersango, one of the UK’s early crypto exchanges. The platform became inaccessible in 2014, leaving users unable to withdraw their funds.
61 Lost Bitcoins Retrieved!
A British guy bought £1,500 of Bitcoin in 2011 through Intersango, the UK's first crypto exchange, then it collapsed in 2014 with his coins frozen inside.
In 2018 the founders emailed him to claim his funds and he deleted it thinking it was a scam.…
For years, Chris tried to recover his Bitcoin but could not get access to the exchange or his account.
Lawyers Traced the Lost Bitcoin
Chris eventually turned to CEL Solicitors in 2026. The legal team gathered old records and other documents to prove that the Bitcoin belonged to him.
Using blockchain tracing, the team identified a wallet containing thousands of Bitcoin that was linked to the failed exchange. After several months of work, 61 BTC were returned to Chris.
The recovery was completed in May 2026, ending a 12-year effort to regain access to the coins.
Chris described watching Bitcoin rise without being able to access his holdings as “a punch in the stomach.”
Recovered Bitcoin Now Worth Around $5M
The value of the recovered Bitcoin has changed dramatically since Chris first bought it.
His original £1,500 investment is now worth roughly £3.3 million, or around $5 million, based on the current value of his 61 BTC.
As of now, Bitcoin is trading around $78K, reflecting a slight rise seen in the last 24 hours.
Chris plans to use some of the money for a larger family home and keep part of the Bitcoin as a long-term holding.

title: British Man Recovers 61 Bitcoin Lost for 12 Years, Now Worth $5M
